writing.text: Last weekend I went to the park with my friend. We eat a lunch on bench and talked about the our job.
I am learning English since two years. Every morning I listen podcast when I go to the work.
My favorite place is a small cafe at my neighborhood. I usually go there in Sunday and read books during three hours.
Today I plan to finish my report and then go for a run before dinner.
The movie was very funny so I was boring at the end. The actor did a great acting.
Yesterday my manager said me that the project is delayed. I was very surprise because we worked hardly for it. I think the problem is not our team but the schedule was too tight from the begin.
